question: For each OECD AIM record, does the retained bundle contain incident narrative sufficient to support a not-recovered judgement, or only material insufficient to assess?
rule: Per retained field: strip leading title; truncate at the outbound article rail; delete site-chrome and OECD-AIM taxonomy marker phrases; require title content-word overlap >= 0.30 AND >=1 sentence of >=40 characters. Identical rule applied to all 100 rows in all three strata.

retained_text_types_observed.a_oecd_aim_taxonomy_tag_block: [AI generated] AI principles / Industries / Affected stakeholders / Harm types
retained_text_types_observed.b_external_headline_and_link: headline + date + outlet + "Why's our monitor labelling this an incident or hazard?"
retained_text_types_observed.c_monitor_classification_rationale: e.g. 'the event fits the definition of an AI Hazard'

candidate_false_negative.retained_text: A Connecticut plaintiff, Matthew Elliott, was sanctioned after embedding hidden AI prompt injections in court filings, aiming to manipulate any AI system reviewing the documents.
candidate_false_negative.issue: Describes a court sanction, i.e. a disposition, yet all six closure components were recorded as not supported.
candidate_false_negative.status: flagged for independent human review; not adjudicated here
